system.name: OAKINK2
system.one_liner: A dataset of bimanual hand-object manipulation for complex daily tasks, organised as affordances, primitive tasks and complex tasks.

content.variant_note: six titled panels in a 2 by 3 grid around a dataset logo box: the top row follows one task through three collection stages, the bottom row shows three levels of abstraction with examples
content.argues: OAKINK2 covers both how complex bimanual tasks are collected and annotated and how they decompose into primitive tasks built on object affordances.
content.subject: Data collection of one tea-preparing task in three panels, and three levels of abstraction with hand-object examples, around a dataset logo box

lessons.what_to_learn: Give a dataset figure two rows with one job each: the top row follows one real task through the collection stages (instruction, demonstration, annotation) and the bottom row shows the levels of abstraction with a tinted band strip beneath naming each level; a logo box in the middle ties them together.
lessons.suits: Dataset or benchmark papers that have both a collection pipeline and a layered annotation scheme and want real samples (photos, renders, text) shown per stage and per level.

OAKINK2 dataset focuses on bimanual object manipulation tasks for complex daily activities.

summary: OAKINK2 is a dataset of bimanual hand-object manipulation for complex daily tasks, organised in three levels of abstraction: Affordance, Primitive Task and Complex Task. Figure 1 is a 2 by 3 grid of grey-framed panels around a central logo box. The top row follows one task, preparing hot sweet fruit tea, through Task Initialization (instruction, photo, description, recipe), Task Process (a film strip of multi-view frames and a narration with highlighted verbs) and Task Annotation (3D hand renders and a dependency graph of action icons). The bottom row shows Level1 affordances as <verb, sth> pills on a bottle, Level2 primitive tasks (unscrew, pour) and Level3 chains (stir, unscrew, pour, scoop), with a tinted band strip underneath.
summary_zh: OakInk2 是双手物体操作数据集，分三层抽象：功能（Affordance）、基本任务、复杂任务。图为 2×3 面板，中间是数据集标识框：上排以一个泡茶任务走完初始化、过程、标注；下排依次展示三个层级的示例，底部用色带标出层名。
